title: Phone-verify entry rules for the top 10 candidate events before booking
detail: One call to Venetian poker (702.414.7657) asking 'maximum entries / re-entry / add-on rules' for Events #26, #47, #56, #59, #14, #5, #10 and the Wynn $200 dailies would convert unverified rows into confirmed ones or remove them from the single-entry list. Record the answer with date and staff name on each row.

title: Add a headless-browser hotel-rate capture to the morning job
detail: The Venetian booking engine is server-rendered (a plain fetch captures full quotes), but Wynn/Caesars/MGM engines are JavaScript-only. A Playwright step in the daily GitHub Action could capture dated quotes for all hotels into the rate log automatically. Note: automation against booking engines should be checked against each site's terms first.

title: Google Distance Matrix API for verified walking times
detail: One API call per hotel–venue pair (needs a Google Maps API key, stored as a GitHub Actions secret) would fill the walking-minutes column from an authoritative routing source and make the ≤30-minute filter fully live. Fallback: a human checks each route link once (5 minutes per pair).

title: Rate-change alerts (email or GitHub issue) when a logged rate moves ≥10%
detail: The re-check job already writes dated rate rows. Adding a threshold check that opens a GitHub issue when the nightly average moves more than 10% between captures would make the monitoring actionable without visiting the site.

title: Extend room coverage to Sahara, Resorts World, STRAT, Park MGM, Mandalay Bay, Cosmopolitan, Planet Hollywood
detail: Each needs one official-page fetch to confirm whether a daily schedule is published; rooms with schedules get rows, rooms without get an official 'no schedule published' note with check date. Script hooks already exist in scripts/scrape_daily.py.

title: Dated-rate log for Wynn/Bellagio/Caesars via official phone quotes
detail: Booking engines aside, reservations lines quote rates that can be recorded verbatim with the quote date — enough for like-for-like totals in the trip calculator (checkout total, nightly average, fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline).

title: Single-entry policy letters from tournament directors
detail: A short standard email to each poker room asking for written freezeout/no-reentry confirmation per event would permanently fix the biggest data gap (currently 0 confirmed single-entry events). Replies become the source excerpts on each row.

title: Export the day-plan as an .ics calendar
detail: Once dates are fixed (Q1), generate an .ics file of the primary+fallback plan so the schedule lives on a phone calendar with late-registration reminders.

title: Auto-diff structure sheets in the morning job
detail: The re-check job currently hashes fetched text and flags changed pages. Extending it to re-parse the per-event fields (buy-in, guarantee, late-reg) would pinpoint which value moved instead of only marking the row changed.

title: Publish a weekly 'what changed' digest on the changelog page
detail: Aggregate data/feature/changes.json into a short weekly summary block at the top of changelog.html so repeat visitors see movement at a glance.
